biggest_catch: The credit size depends on the referred friend's annual propane volume, so you cannot know in advance whether you will earn $50 or $300 CAD — and the friend must actually get their propane tank filled, not just sign up.
catches: Reward tiers depend on the referred customer's annual propane volume: 1,000 L or less = $50, 1,001–2,500 L = $100, 2,501–3,500 L = $200, 3,500+ L = $300.
Both sides earn account credits only when the referred friend gets their propane tank filled.
Amounts are in Canadian dollars (Avenir Energy is a Canadian propane supplier); no USD equivalent stated.
The page does not state an exact payout timeline after the tank fill.
Savings framing: account credits reduce planned propane spending; not cash income. Referrer side requires already being an Avenir customer.

steps: As an Avenir Energy propane customer, refer a friend who could benefit from Avenir as their propane supplier (your credit lands on your Avenir account).
Your friend becomes an Avenir Energy customer and gets their propane tank filled.
Both you and your friend earn account credits: $50 (1,000 L or less annual volume), $100 (1,001-2,500 L), $200 (2,501-3,500 L), or $300 (3,500+ L).
Credits are applied to your Avenir accounts, reducing future propane bills.
